scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:shaders && npm run build:wasm && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json
scripts.test:ts: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && mocha "dist-test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:ts
scripts.smoke: npm run smoke:rust && npm run smoke:browser
scripts.smoke:terrain-seams: cargo run -p ofg_test_harness --bin ofg-render-smoke -- --out artifacts/rust-smoke --scenario seams
scripts.smoke:terrain-presets: cargo run -p ofg_test_harness --bin ofg-render-smoke -- --out artifacts/rust-smoke --scenario presets
scripts.watch: npm run build:shaders && npm run build:wasm && tsc -p tsconfig.json --watch
